h2: Pool Cleaning Seminyak – Fast Service Between Guest Check-ins
intro: Pool Cleaning Seminyak covers everything from a quick pre-arrival skim-and-brush to full green-pool recovery when algae has taken hold over a rainy week. In dense lanes like Petitenget or Oberoi, villas sit close together with older pipework, so water balance drifts faster than you'd expect between bookings. Send a couple of photos on WhatsApp and we'll scope the job before anyone arrives.

sections.h3: Why Seminyak Pools Need More Attention Than You Think
sections.text: Villas around Batu Belig are often 15–25 years old, meaning tired pump seals, corroded filter housings and heaters that struggle under constant daily use. High occupancy means the pool takes a real beating between check-out and check-in—leaves, sunscreen residue and foot traffic all shift pH and chlorine within days. Tight plots and shared walls also make equipment rooms harder to reach, so a technician familiar with the layout saves time and avoids damage to neighbouring structures.

sections.h3: What a Typical One-Off Clean Involves Here
sections.text: A standard visit starts with skimming surface debris, brushing walls and steps, then vacuuming the basin floor. We backwash the sand or cartridge filter, test and adjust chlorine, pH and alkalinity, and wipe down the waterline tiles where limescale bonds fastest on older grout. If the water has gone green or cloudy after heavy rain, we shock-treat, rebalance over one or two sessions, and confirm clarity before your guests arrive. Every job is scoped from photos first, so you know exactly what's included.

sections.h3: How to Request a Quote on WhatsApp
sections.text: Snap two or three photos: one wide shot of the pool and deck, one close-up of the water surface showing any green film or cloudiness, and one of the equipment area if you can reach it. Add a short note—guest arrival date, whether the pump is running, any recent heavy rain flooding the lane. Send everything straight to our WhatsApp number. Pricing depends on the actual job, so we'll come back with a quote based on those photos before anyone shows up.

sections.h3: Keeping Your Pool Stable Between Bookings
sections.text: Run the filter at least six hours daily even when the villa sits empty—stagnant water in this heat breeds algae within a day or two. After heavy rain floods the lanes around Oberoi or Petitenget, empty the skimmer basket and bump chlorine, because street runoff drags leaves and oils straight into your basin. Wipe the waterline tiles weekly with a gentle descaler to stop limescale bonding to older grout. Keep a basic test kit beside the pump room so you spot pH drift early, before it becomes a green-pool emergency between guests.

faq.q: How long does a green pool recovery take?
faq.a: It depends on how far the algae has progressed; a single shock-treat plus rebalancing often clears it in one visit, while heavier cases need two sessions spaced a day apart. Send photos on WhatsApp and we'll tell you which scenario applies.

faq.q: Do you handle villas where the equipment room is hard to reach?
faq.a: Yes—tight plots and shared walls are common across Seminyak's older lanes, and we work around those constraints regularly. Just mention any access issues in your WhatsApp message so we bring the right tools.

faq.q: Can you clean the pool the morning before my guests check in?
faq.a: That's actually our most common request given how busy rentals run here. Share your arrival time and a photo of the current water state on WhatsApp, and we'll confirm whether a same-day slot works for that specific job.
